test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table, facing towards the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Two boys are sitting on each side. G and C are sitting on the same side. E is sitting opposite to G and E is to the immediate right of B. F and H are sitting on the adjacent side of G and C. F and H are sitting on the same side. H is fourth to the left of B. D is not the immediate neighbour of G. Which of the following pairs of boys represent the boys sitting on the same side of the square table?
solution: Given: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H. All are sitting around a square table, facing towards the centre. 1) Two boys are sitting on each side. 2) H is fourth to the left of B. 3) F and H are sitting on the same side.
